newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-COACH MAGATH EXTENDS HAMBURG CONTRACT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-COACH MAGATH EXTENDS HAMBURG CONTRACT.

text.p: Hamburg reached agreement with their coach Felix Magath on Thursday on a new contract which will keep the former German international at the club until 1999.
Magath took charge last October when Hamburg were in the relegation zone and led them to a UEFA Cup berth. His current contract was due to expire at the end of this season.
"I'm pleased everything's settled," Magath said. "I think it's good for the team to know where they stand."
Magath was promoted from the post of assistant coach to replace Benno Moehlmann, who was sacked shortly after former World Cup player Uwe Seeler became president of the club.
Hamburg have impressed in the UEFA Cup under Magath this season but have struggled to find form in the league.
